easy.title: A Bowl by the Hoard
easy.lore: After the last footsteps faded, I carried water through the Rotunda. Malgrath drank without lifting his head. Nothing in the guild's songs mentions the bowl. I think it may be the most important thing in this room.

normal.title: The Place We Kept
normal.lore: The gunner picked spent cases out of the gold while I reset the door. Malgrath asked whether anyone had broken the little garden pot. I told him no. Only then did he close his eyes.

hard.title: Still Here
hard.lore: The twentieth banner fell where the first had stood. For a while none of us moved. Then Malgrath shifted one wing, and the whole room breathed again. We had held a place. We had kept a life inside it.

easy.title: Across the Crack
easy.lore: I cut the guild banner free from the old bridge. It vanished into the glow before the cloth had finished turning. The stone stayed warm under my boots long after the fighting stopped.

normal.title: A Wing Remembered
normal.lore: The Rift lit the marks Malgrath's claws had left on the bank. They were higher than my head. I put my hand in one and tried to imagine the weight of him standing there, impatient to fly.

hard.title: The Cooler Bank
hard.lore: We held the narrow ledge until the last armored fighter fell. Across the crack, the far road was empty. I sat where Malgrath used to land and let the heat dry the shaking out of my hands.

easy.title: The Last Echo
easy.lore: The halls repeated our victory long after we stopped calling to each other. Somewhere near the far door, an echo sounded like a laugh. I let it. It had been too long since the stone had heard one.

normal.title: Borrowed Helm
normal.lore: A squire had left a helm beside the lowest stair. I set it upright instead of kicking it away. It was much too large for whoever had worn it. There are things a guild should not ask a child to carry.

hard.title: No More Footsteps
hard.lore: We waited for another formation. The echoes gave us our own breathing, a settling beam, the scrape of a sling stone put back in a pocket. At last I turned toward the garden. No one followed us from the far end.

easy.title: Pale Flowers
easy.lore: A flower opened beside a scorch mark while we were clearing the path. The frost mage stepped around it. I did too. We left the mark where it was and carried the broken stone elsewhere.

normal.title: The Wrong Sky
normal.lore: Malgrath had once told me the tree did not need our sky. After the defense, I found a new leaf folded beneath a root. There was no sun to thank. There was water, and room, and another night without the guild.

hard.title: Room to Grow
hard.lore: We held every entrance, and the garden kept its water. When the quiet came, the gunner sat under the pale branches. None of us spoke. The flowers opened around our boots as though we belonged there.

easy.title: An Ember Kept
easy.lore: Malgrath's breathing was shallow when I reached him. I counted until it steadied, then forgot the count. Behind us, the last gate was still standing. For tonight, that was enough.

normal.title: His Name, Quietly
normal.lore: The guild champion had called him a beast. When the chamber was ours again, I said his name. Malgrath opened one eye. There are words that take something away, and words that give it back.

hard.title: The Heart Held
hard.lore: The last blow struck the gate and did not open it. I stayed beside Malgrath until the heat returned to the stone. He asked whether it was morning. I said it could be, if he wanted. We had earned that much.

easy.title: A Map Left Open
easy.lore: I came back with a map that no longer agreed with the road. Malgrath studied it as if the mistake were interesting. Perhaps it was. We had found another way home.

normal.title: The Road That Moved
normal.lore: The path folded behind us, but every ally made it through the last bend. I marked the exit with a stone from the Rotunda. By morning it was still there. For once, the Depths had kept something I gave them.

hard.title: Home by Another Way
hard.lore: No banner reached the far end of the shifting road. I brought the empty map back through every chamber we had held. Malgrath listened while I described them. The lair was larger than the siege now.
